board: NXP MPX5010DP bare sensor, 6-pin unibody package (case 867C), pins VOUT, GND, VCC, V1, V2, VEX
reason: Check passed on ESP32 and Pico (spec, wiring, design checks, breadboard, simulator test, PCB DRC, footprint, LCSC). Model uses the datasheet transfer function Vout = VS(0.09P + 0.04), 0.2-4.7 V at 5 V, and the docs warn that VOUT needs a 10k/20k divider above about 6.9 kPa on 3.3 V boards.
